transcript.text: Zanussi dishwasher keeps tripping the electrics, not every time though. Usually about 15 mins in. Model ZDT21006FA

⚠ Stop using this appliance
Please don't keep resetting the trip. Leave the appliance unplugged and have it checked by a qualified electrician or appliance engineer before using it again. Because your Zanussi ZDT21006FA is tripping the electricity, it must be unplugged immediately. Do not use it again until an engineer has checked it. In most dishwashers, this is when the heating cycle begins. The most likely cause is that the heating element has developed an insulation fault (a 'leak to earth'), which trips the safety switch once it gets hot or wet. Please unplug the machine first. Once safe, you can check if there are obvious cracks in the ceramic parts of the heater element at the bottom of the tub. However, because this involves internal electrical components and water, I strongly recommend calling a qualified engineer to test and replace the faulty part safely.

reading.symptom: keeps tripping the electrics, not every time though. Usually about 15 mins in.

plan: Safety: a supply trip hazard is active. The fixed safety warning is shown separately, do not repeat it. It must not be used again until a qualified engineer has checked it: say that plainly. You may explain the likely cause and suggest checks that are safe with it switched off and unplugged, but never say or imply that a check could make it safe to use, or that they might not need an engineer.
Already given by the customer, never ask for it again: make Zanussi; model ZDT21006FA.
The fault they reported is: "keeps tripping the electrics, not every time though. Usually about 15 mins in.". Keep to it: never describe a symptom, result or state they have not told you.

Stage 1 (broad help): say what could cause this, most likely first, as possibilities rather than certainties, including simple causes (settings, loading, detergent, installation, or normal behaviour) where they fit. Then give the one or two safe checks, or the one question, that would best tell those causes apart. Do not ask for the model number in this reply.
